free_tier.stated: No free text allowance; the API enforces monthly spend caps and per-tier RPM/ITPM/OTPM limits, and new organizations start in an Evaluation tier with lower limits.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: Anthropic SDKs and the Messages API
chaining: no free text tier; even the new-account Evaluation tier is a paid arrangement

limits.value: Evaluation tier starts below standard limits; Start tier $500 USD monthly spend cap

identity_cost.detail: an account and API key; card/billing setup is needed for paid usage after credits

reliability_note: ramp limits and a monthly spend cap can pause API usage; spend-cap 429 has no retry-after header

evidence.proved: new organizations start in an Evaluation tier and a monthly spend cap applies
evidence.quote: New organizations and organizations with limited usage history may start in the Evaluation tier

notes: No standing free text tier documented on the rate-limits page; the consumer Claude Free plan is a different product.
